story.head: The Islanders can’t afford to take penalties
paras: The Islanders won the teams’ first meeting this season, 6-0 on Long Island on Oct 3. The Devils (9-5-0) beat Vegas 5-2 on Oct 30, while the Islanders (7-5-2) lost 4-0 to Edmonton on Oct 31. This is a Metropolitan Division matchup, with the Devils second (tied for eighth in the NHL) and the Isles fourth (tied for 17th).

The Devils have played better than their record (.643) says: their chances are worth about .741, and their goaltending has held them back. The Islanders’ record (.571) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.515), largely thanks to their goaltending.

The Devils keep things calm after the whistle (2nd lowest) and keep shots away better than almost anyone (3rd), but get pinned in their own end on long shifts (30th). The Islanders have had some of the league’s best goaltending (2nd) and spread the ice time through the lineup (3rd). They also get their defensemen shooting (1st), so their defensemen shoot a lot, and the Devils’ not so much. The Devils’ power play (6th) could do real damage against the Islanders’ penalty kill (29th), though their penalty killers create chances of their own going the other way.

Jack Hughes (6 G / 10 A / 16 P in 14 GP) leads the Devils in scoring, with seven points in his last five games and six goals in nine games against the Islanders since 2023-24. Arseny Gritsyuk (8 G / 4 A / 12 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. Bo Horvat (7 G / 7 A / 14 P in 14 GP) is tied for the Islanders’ scoring lead, with eight goals in ten games against New Jersey since 2023-24. Matthew Schaefer (4 G / 10 A / 14 P in 14 GP) shares it.
Jake Allen (5-3-0 / .886 SV% in 8 GS) is in line to start for New Jersey. Ilya Sorokin (6-4-0 / .911 SV% in 10 GS) has been a rock in net for the Islanders and will likely start.

items.text: Anthony Duclair has five goals in six games against New Jersey since 2023-24.
The Devils are newly without Anthony Mantha.

The Islanders are newly without Ryan Pulock, have been without Matias Maccelli since Oct 17, and have had to make do without Mathew Barzal all season. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, no team is missing more right now.
Arseny Gritsyuk has seven goals on chances worth about 3.4 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
